QueryDiskList.marker: The starting position of the query for retrieving the list in batch, a string generated by the system
QueryDiskList.maxKeys: The maximum number of items per page, usually no more than 1000. The default value is 1000
QueryDiskList.instanceId: Instance ID, used to query the disk list attached to the instance (including the system disk). Leave this parameter empty to query all disks created by the user.
QueryDiskList.chargeFilter: CDS billing type, valid values: postpay/prepay
QueryDiskList.usageFilter: CDS disk type, valid values: system/data
QueryDiskList.name: CDS disk name
QueryDiskList.productCategory: Filter disks by the service type of the attached instance, optional values include BCC/HPAS
